news.title: Military aircraft to fly over Lawrence campus Thursday, Friday in advance of KU-Missouri football game
news.summary_en: Military jets will fly over the University of Kansas campus Thursday, Sept. 10, and Friday, Sept. 11, in advance of Friday's KU football game versus the University of Missouri.

news.title: KU Law to host environmental law scholar James Salzman for lecture on drinking water
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Law will host environmental law scholar James Salzman for a public lecture Sept. 14. “The Past, Present, and Future of Drinking Water” will take place from 4:30 to 6 p.m. in 106 Green Hall at the University of Kansas School of Law.

news.title: Indigenous Arts Initiative will offer workshops on art, filmmaking
news.summary_en: The Indigenous Arts Initiative, which includes partners from the University of Kansas, will bring two distinguished Indigenous artists and educators to Lawrence this September for a series of free public workshops exploring art, culture, storytelling and filmmaking.

news.title: Study finds common vaping additives disrupt lung-surfactant film in lab model
news.summary_en: A new study from the University of Kansas shows that additives common to commercially available vaping devices, vitamin E and CBD, soften a vital lung surfactant at high enough concentrations, at least in a simplified lab model.

news.title: KU to host inaugural Democracy Day, featuring presentations by university researchers
news.summary_en: The Center for Democratic Governance at the University of Kansas is hosting its first annual Democracy Day “Teach-In” Event on Sept. 18 in the Alderson Auditorium of the Kansas Union.

news.title: KU Architecture Lecture Series to explore contemporary architectural practice in Mexico
news.summary_en: Award-winning architects from some of Mexico’s most influential contemporary practices will visit the University of Kansas this fall as part of the Architecture Lecture Series, “Re-Generations.” Through four public presentations, speakers will share perspectives on design, urbanism and the evolving role of architecture in shaping communities and culture.

news.title: ‘News Desert U’ book explores what happens when ‘universities own the news’
news.summary_en: The new book “News Desert U” examines six university community partnerships in which faculty and students produce news for communities that have lost coverage. The book’s authors, including a University of Kansas journalism faculty member, explore lessons learned and argue for more support from universities to faculty who are leading such efforts.
